claim.message: the namespace IS reachable — the fault is further in

what-happened: HELD, on the third round that could ask and replicated by its pair. Rounds 096 and 097 both record `the namespace IS reachable - the fault is further in` with `parts: 0` and `observedBeforeTheRound: true` — so the replay carried it across the trace mark exactly as intended. THE EXPENSIVE HALF IS REFUTED: the customXmlParts surface is NOT dead on this host, so #583 does not need a product decision. `getByNamespace(...).getCount()` answers reliably; it is getOnlyItemOrNullObject/load/getXml that hangs, and `parts: 0` says the call that hangs is the one asking for the only item of an EMPTY collection — the state every unbranded deck is in, i.e. every pane load in the wild. Fixed by counting first and never making that call unless the count is 1. This also explains the intermittency recorded after round 092: the manual button clicks that answered in 428ms hit the same empty namespace and did NOT hang, so the hang is a race rather than a property of the empty case — the guard removes the call rather than the race.

because: A CLAIM THAT CANNOT WRIGGLE. `traceEnvironment` emits `host`/`environment` unconditionally — no branch, no host call it depends on — and it appears in 0 of the 69 archived rounds, on an archive where every build contains the emitting line.
